scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Let's place your first order. Enter your email, and we'll send you a code.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: That's you signed in. {0.3} From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order starts out empty. {0.3} Add a person to it, and the rest follows from there.

scenes.label: add-a-person
scenes.line: You can add yourself, or invite a party member to rent alongside you.

scenes.label: member-added
scenes.line: You are on the order now.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection to see the items inside it. {0.3} A collection holds gear of the same kind, so you can compare before you choose.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Now pick your dates. {0.3} Choose the day you will pick the gear up, then the day you will bring it back. {0.3} We hold your items for every day in between, and the calendar only offers days we can actually fill. {0.3} For a single day, tap the same date twice.

scenes.label: item-on-the-order
scenes.line: Your item is on the order, with its dates and its price. {0.3} Check both before you carry on.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now a few questions, so your gear is fitted and waiting before you get here. {0.3} Your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. {0.3} We set the bindings from these, which saves you time at the counter. {0.3} Then agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: order-total
scenes.line: Here is your total, with the tax broken out. {0.3} Take a moment over the dates and the price, because this is the last stop before payment.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

scenes.label: order-complete
scenes.line: That is your order placed. {0.3} Your invoice is ready, and your gear will be waiting for you at the store on your pickup day.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Your rental now sits in your order history, so you can come back to it any time. {0.3} Your details are saved too, which makes your next booking a good deal quicker.

scenes.label: logged-out
scenes.line: You are signed out. Thank you for renting with Ski Demo, and we will see you on the hill.
